analyst.summary: LG Electronics India is a high-quality, low-debt consumer-durables leader (ACs, refrigerators, washing machines, TVs) that IPO'd in October 2025 to a euphoric 50% listing pop, but FY26 earnings tell a much more sober story: full-year revenue was flat (+1%) and net profit fell 24% versus FY25, with two of the four quarters posting profit declines of 27% and 62% on margin pressure from currency and marketing costs, only partially offset by a GST-cut-aided record Q4 revenue quarter. At roughly 64x trailing earnings on declining profits, the stock is priced for a growth and margin recovery that has not yet shown up in the numbers; Q1 FY27 results (due late July/August 2026) are the next real test. We are holding rather than selling because the quant score and balance-sheet quality remain intact, but we are flagging this one for portfolio-manager review given how rich the multiple looks against the trend.
